question: By whom was the teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs transmitted?
premises: The earth-movers, described as good eaters, are the subject.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs was transmitted by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The form bhūcarī is taken as instrumental singular, though its ending is ambiguous.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
